findings.issue: The Vibe agent profiles are stale against their canonical sources. HEAD commit 32fec82b0e4 added the sentence 'Keep the question and each scope entry within 500 characters on one line, because admission prunes a longer row as relevance' to .skilled/agents/deep-research.md:302 and .skilled/agents/deep-review.md:267. It regenerated the .claude, .codex, .pi and .dsh mirrors but not .vibe/agents/deep-research.toml or .vibe/agents/deep-review.toml, which are headed 'Generated by sync-agents-vibe.cjs ... do not edit by hand'. Diffing the decoded instructions against the canonical bodies shows that sentence is the only difference. Reach: the vibe-mirror job in .github/workflows/command-tree-parity.yml (lines 153-187), a workflow S15-workflow-select chose for this scope, runs 'sync-agents-vibe.cjs --check' and fails on this drift unless the SKILLED_CI or SKILLED_CI_TESTS variable turns it off. Spec-kit-check.yml:357 runs the same check. The surface map misses it because S11's battery replays only the codex, pi and runtime-mirror syncs, not the vibe or dsh agent syncs, so all four .vibe and .dsh files were left uncovered. sync-agents-dsh.cjs --check passes (11 patches in sync), and the vibe prompt and skill checks pass. Fix: run node .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/vibe/sync-agents-vibe.cjs and commit both profiles.

findings.issue: This is the research-side counterpart of B4-1, which covered only the review entry. The range adds FRONTIER_FAILED_STATUSES to deep-research/scripts/reduce-state.cjs (line 2486, absent at base 21c4b325b5a). frontierNodeVisitRecords (line 2492) drops records with status error, failed, failure or timeout before counting frontier visits, and the code comment says the focus pick, the band budget and the dashboard all count visits that way. The research expansive-depth catalog entry describes the tie-break on fewest visits (line 38) and the 50/35/15 band spend 'once a band's visits reach its share' (line 42), but never says a failed or timed-out attempt is not a visit. An operator reading it would expect a timed-out iteration to spend band share and to count in the fewest-visits tie-break. Add one sentence to the band-budget passage.
